intro: A curated set of tools, repositories and organizations we think every imager should know about.

links.name: MicroscopyU
links.description: Nikon's microscopy education resource — in-depth technique guides, tutorials and interactive calculators covering confocal, light sheet, super-resolution and more.

links.name: image.sc Forum
links.description: The community forum for scientific imaging software — ImageJ/Fiji, napari and the broader community answer your analysis questions.

links.name: mesoSPIM Initiative
links.description: Open-source light-sheet microscopes for imaging cleared tissue — the initiative behind the three MesoSPIMs built and used at the CBI.

links.name: Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center
links.description: A joint CMU–Pitt facility enabling discovery since 1986, with HPC allocations on Bridges-2, Anton and Neocortex.

links.name: Brain Image Library
links.description: A BRAIN Initiative data archive of high-resolution microscopy — petabytes of open data, free for researchers everywhere.
